prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Create a completely new fictional editorial healthcare photograph from this text description, without using any previous photograph as a reference.
Art direction: bright, vibrant, uplifting, welcoming and full of life. Bring the joyful saturated colors of the Nubo app into real materials in the scene. Palette reference: teal #238083, clear blue #3176ae, violet #7754b3, berry pink #ac487b, warm orange #b75715, and fresh green #3c8154. Use the selected colors for this particular scene as substantial, clearly visible splashes on clothing, blankets, cushions and a few room details. Color should be apparent immediately at thumbnail size. Preserve natural skin tones and neutral whites; colors belong to real objects and textiles, never a global orange or teal cast. Rich color separation with lively midtones, no gloomy beige-and-sage treatment, muddy grading, faded colors or grey haze. Do not put all six colors into every image.
Photographic treatment: convincing full-frame DSLR photography, 50 mm prime lens, f/5.6, ISO 100. Abundant soft daylight and white bounce light, airy open shadows, bright clean exposure without blown highlights. Authentic candid expressions, fine natural skin texture, lifelike eyes, individual hair strands, real textile weave and believable anatomy. All faces clearly resolved on a shared focal plane. A welcoming contemporary children's healthcare environment with a few colorful art prints and healthy green plants, uncluttered and believable. Not a themed playroom or rainbow mural. No digital sharpening, HDR halos, hard clarity effect, beauty retouching, banding, ringing or plastic skin.
Composition: landscape 2:1 website hero. Keep the LEFT HALF quiet and bright for an overlaid headline, a light neutral wall with gentle daylight. Concentrate the human interaction in a compact group in the RIGHT HALF; all faces should remain in the right half, with space above heads. Camera at eye level, medium-wide framing. The people and their expressions are the focus. No person faces the camera. Keep the child's entire body safely supported and visible. Keep ordinary hospital or exam-room details subtle.
Include exactly one normal-sized iPhone lying screen-down naturally on the bedding within easy reach, rear cameras visible, as a secondary detail. No screens, text, recording graphics, floating UI, watermark, branding, dramatic distress, procedures or extra people.

Scene and emotion: the first hospital days after a birth, tender joy and reassurance. A mother with her hair loosely tied back sits supported by pillows, wearing a modest white hospital gown with small violet details. She safely cradles a sleeping newborn in a white swaddle with a violet-and-coral trim and looks lovingly down into the baby's face, a soft affectionate smile. A woman doctor in rich TEAL scrubs and a stethoscope sits beside the bed at eye level, offering a warm reassuring smile. A substantial clear BLUE blanket lies across mother's lap, with a soft lavender cushion and one small warm orange floral accent nearby. These vivid clean textiles are clearly visible, complemented by bright white bedding and a fresh green plant. Mother can look gently tired but her connection to the newborn and the room feel hopeful and sunlit, not sombre. Forearms fully support baby's head and body. Phone lies on the blue blanket. Exactly three people including the newborn. Dominant accents: teal, blue and violet, with a little warm coral.
